notes: Wave E puzzle framework (12_Systems/dungeons_and_puzzles.md). Every puzzle is optional (Canon: puzzles are never a mandatory gate), can be skipped for free, has free hints and a free assist, and pays only an optional item reward. Numbers are placeholders until the user tunes them.

puzzles.name: The Tally Levers
hints: The kobold tally-keepers chalked four marks on the landing wall, one for each lever.
Read the chalk marks from the bottom up: slate, ash, chalk, tin.
A wrong pull only resets the tally. Nothing is lost.

puzzles.name: The Weighing Floor
hints: Each plate wants an exact weight. Too much and the stone pops back up.
The east plate takes 3, the west plate takes 5.
Try the heaviest stone on the east plate, then fill the west plate with the rest.

puzzles.name: The Resonance Lock
hints: The old runesmiths set four sconces to match the mural above the cistern.
Turning a sconce also turns its neighbour. Start from the far left.
Each sconce cycles ember, tide, gale, stone and then back to ember.
